C bf.goal OL WF-015,WF-008,GOV-014 MUST ;; Restore the affected scope to green without hiding failures, weakening behaviour or adding unrelated changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf013.reproduce OL WF-013 MUST ;; Reproduce and diagnose the actual failure before editing; do not guess. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf013.root-cause OL WF-013 MUST ;; Fix root causes before downstream symptoms. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf014.bounded OL WF-014 MUST ;; Small bounded iterations; re-run the narrowest failing verification after each fix; expand only after the focused failure is resolved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf015.no-weakening OL WF-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not weaken, delete, skip or suppress tests or compiler/analyzer/TypeScript/lint failures to pass. ;; = ;; none ;;
C bf.preserve OL GOV-014,RUN-009,ARC-001 MUST ;; Preserve architecture and project conventions while fixing. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf014.stalled OL WF-014,WF-008 MUST ;; Stop when progress has clearly stalled rather than making speculative edits. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf013.scope-first OL WF-013 MUST ;; Decide the affected scope (backend, frontend, both, contract/client generation, dependencies, toolchain) before running commands. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.no-unrelated-builds OL WF-007,WF-014 MUST_NOT ;; Do not run unrelated build systems merely because they exist. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf014.narrowest OL WF-014 MUST ;; Start with the narrowest command that reliably reproduces the problem. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf013.actual-scripts OL WF-013,WF-018 MUST ;; Inspect package.json and use scripts that exist; do not invent script names or assume a test runner (baseline runner in docs/capabilities/frontend.md; existing projects may use another). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf013.full-output OL WF-013 MUST ;; Read the complete failure output, group errors by root cause, fix the highest-leverage cause first. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf014.backend-loop OL WF-013,WF-014 MUST ;; Backend loop: reproduce, identify root cause, inspect source/references/packages, smallest change, re-run, compare failure sets, expand after focused fix. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.no-invalid-refs OL ARC-001,WF-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not solve dependency problems with invalid project references (e.g. Application→Infrastructure). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf014.frontend-loop OL WF-013,WF-014 MUST ;; Frontend loop: inspect package.json/config, reproduce, read diagnostic, inspect affected code, smallest change, re-run, broaden after focused fix. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.follow-frontend-rules OL WF-001 MUST ;; Follow frontend.md, frontend-framework.md and the frontend knowledge skill while repairing frontend failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf015.frontend-no-silencing OL WF-015,FE-001,DEP-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not convert to any, disable strict mode, suppress template diagnostics, reintroduce restricted legacy constructs, replace framework APIs speculatively or add state/HTTP libraries to bypass a local issue. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf013.contract-authoritative OL WF-013,WF-016 MUST ;; For cross-stack failures determine the authoritative contract; do not patch both sides into inconsistent shapes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf016.client-regen OL WF-016 MUST ;; With OpenAPI client generation verify the backend contract, regenerate with the normal workflow, review, then fix handwritten code. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf014.test-fix OL WF-013,WF-014 MUST ;; Test-fix flow: read test and production behaviour, locate the defect, smallest change, re-run affected tests, broaden after. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf015.no-weak-assertions OL WF-015,GOV-014 MUST_NOT ;; Do not weaken assertions or delete/skip failing tests; update tests only for intentionally changed and requested behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf013.dependency-diagnosis OL WF-013 MUST ;; After dependency changes inspect versions, compatibility, peers, diagnostics and migration docs; update usage deliberately. ;; = ;; none ;;
C bf.dependency-rules OL DEP-003,DEP-002,DEP-001,DEP-006,DEP-007 MUST_NOT ;; Dependency changes during repair go through add-dependency; no package swaps to get green; no duplicated versions in .csproj; preserve the lockfile and do not delete package-lock.json reflexively. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf013.upgrade OL WF-013,GOV-014 MUST ;; After framework upgrades inspect versions, distinguish compile from runtime changes, check migration docs, update deliberately, preserve architecture/behaviour, no unrelated additional upgrade. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bf-no-fabricated-apis EX WF-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not fabricate replacement APIs from memory when they can be verified. ;; = ;; none ;; Verification obligation not in the oracle.
C wf013.toolchain OL WF-013 MUST ;; Determine whether the failure comes from source or the local toolchain (versions, global.json, TFM, lockfile, CI config). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bf-toolchain EX DEP-008,WF-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not change declared SDK/Node/framework/language versions because the local machine differs; report an unresolvable toolchain limitation instead of editing source. ;; = ;; none ;; Toolchain rule beyond the oracle.
C wf016.fix-at-source OL WF-016 DEFAULT ;; For wrong generated output identify generator and input, fix the authoritative source and regenerate; no manual patching unless the output is maintained source. ;; = ;; Intentionally maintained output. ;;
C wf014.limits OL WF-014,WF-008 MUST ;; Bounded iteration; stop and reassess on repeated surviving failures, growing unrelated failures, incompatible toolchain, unavailable infrastructure, unresolvable packages or undeterminable behaviour; no repeated failed guesses. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf008.regressions OL WF-008,GOV-014 MUST ;; Revert or correct fixes introducing new failures unless legitimately dependent; never leave the repository knowingly worse; no unrelated pre-existing failure cleanup unless blocking or requested. ;; = ;; none ;;
C bf.no-arch-bypass OL ARC-001,ARC-008,ARC-011,SEC-005,FE-003 MUST_NOT ;; A build fix must not bypass architecture (Application→Infrastructure, technology types in Application, controller business logic, frontend-only auth, scattered HTTP calls). ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.probes OL TST-010 MUST ;; A behavioural test/probe that establishes behaviour falls under verify's preservation step before removal; build/compiler/analysis commands need no new tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.completion OL WF-005,WF-007 MUST ;; Complete when the affected scope is green (builds, affected tests, consistent contract, no new regression, no workaround); do not require unrelated builds. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.then-verify OL WF-003 MUST ;; Run verify for the final completion pass when appropriate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf009.status-report OL WF-009 MUST ;; Report backend build, frontend build and tests as PASS / NOT RUN / NOT APPLICABLE. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.bf-report-format EX WF-009 MUST ;; Build-fix report includes Initial failure, Root cause, Changes made and Remaining issues. ;; = ;; none ;; Report field structure beyond WF-009.
C wf009.no-false-fixed OL WF-009,WF-008 MUST_NOT ;; Do not claim the problem is fixed while a known relevant failure remains. ;; = ;; none ;;
